name: class-person
description: Create a Person class with methods

variants.typescript: Write a TypeScript class called `Person` with properties: name (string), age (number), and email (string). Add a method `getInfo()` that returns a string with the person's details. Include an interface `IPerson` and proper type annotations. Export both.
variants.javascript: Write a JavaScript class called `Person` with properties: name, age, and email. Add a method `getInfo()` that returns a string with the person's details. Export the class.
variants.javascript-jsdoc: Write a JavaScript class called `Person` with properties: name, age, and email. Add a method `getInfo()` that returns a string with the person's details. Include JSDoc type annotations with @typedef for a Person type, @class, @param, and @return tags. Export the class.

testCases.test: const p = new Person('John', 30, 'john@test.com'); console.assert(p.name === 'John', 'Name should be set');
const p = new Person('John', 30, 'john@test.com'); console.assert(typeof p.getInfo() === 'string', 'getInfo should return string');
const p = new Person('John', 30, 'john@test.com'); console.assert(p.getInfo().includes('John'), 'getInfo should include name');
